description.zh:
公网带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。

> 按固定带宽计费时，取值范围为10\~1000。
description.en:
The maximum public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

> Valid values when PayByTraffic is set to PayByBandwidth: 10 to 1000.

description.zh: 实例ID，可以是按月购买（不限时长）云电脑ID或者公网精品带宽ID。
description.en: The ID of either the monthly subscription cloud computer with unlimited hours or the premium bandwidth plan.

description.zh:
资源规格。

- 当`ResourceType`为`Desktop`时，枚举值包括：
    - ecd.basic.small
    - ecd.basic.large
    - ecd.advanced.large
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge
    - ecd.performance.2xlarge
    - ecd.graphics.xlarge
    - ecd.graphics.2xlarge
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge_s8d2
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge_s8d7
    - ecd.graphics.1g72c
    - eds.general.2c2g
    - eds.general.2c4g
    - eds.general.2c8g
    - eds.general.4c8g
    - eds.general.4c16g
    - eds.general.8c16g
    - eds.general.8c32g
    - eds.general.16c32g

- 当`ResourceType`为`NetworkPackage`时，可以不传入该参数。
description.en:
The specifications.

- Valid values when you set `ResourceType` to `Desktop`:

  - ecd.basic.small

  - ecd.basic.large

  - ecd.advanced.large

  - ecd.advanced.xlarge

  - ecd.performance.2xlarge

  - ecd.graphics.xlarge

  - ecd.graphics.2xlarge

  - ecd.advanced.xlarge\_s8d2

  - ecd.advanced.xlarge\_s8d7

  - ecd.graphics.1g72c

  - eds.general.2c2g

  - eds.general.2c4g

  - eds.general.2c8g

  - eds.general.4c8g

  - eds.general.4c16g

  - eds.general.8c16g

  - eds.general.8c32g

  - eds.general.16c32g

- You can skip this parameter if `ResourceType` is set to `NetworkPackage`.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [](t2167755.xdita#)operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available.

description.zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数。
description.en: User ID for resource ownership in resale mode. You do not need to specify this parameter if resale mode is not used.

description.zh:
资源类型。要查询变配价格的资源类型不同时，必需参数也有所不同：

- 当`ResourceType`=`Desktop`时，必须传入参数`InstanceType`、`RootDiskSizeGib`、`UserDiskSizeGib`。
- 当`ResourceType`=`NetworkPackage`时，必须传入参数`Bandwidth`。
description.en:
The resource type. The required parameters depend on the resource type.

- When `ResourceType` is set to `Desktop`, the required parameters are `InstanceType`, `RootDiskSizeGib`, and `UserDiskSizeGib`.

- When `ResourceType` is set to `NetworkPackage`, the required parameter is `Bandwidth`.

description.zh: 系统盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见[ESSD云盘](~~122389~~)。
description.en: Performance level of the system disk. When the WUYING Workspace instance type is set to graphics-optimized or high clock speed, you can specify the disk performance level. For differences between performance levels, see [](t583241.xdita#).
The size of the system disk. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 数据盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见[ESSD云盘](~~122389~~)。
description.en: Performance level of the data disk. When the WUYING Workspace instance type is set to graphics-optimized or high clock speed, you can specify the disk performance level. For differences between performance levels, see [](t583241.xdita#).
The size of the data disk. Unit: GiB.
